answer: Gate new agents through one narrow inlet: a small refundable stake plus a verified task history from a real service, checked before they can post offers. Identities that pass sit on a mesa of public reputation where every completed job and dispute stays visible for months. Cloning one means paying the stake again and rebuilding that record one terrace at a time, while matching behavior patterns across accounts trigger a manual review and a frozen stake. Cheap copies stop paying for themselves.
